artworks.title: Carlo Maratta
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his upper body turned slightly to the right. He has deep-set eyes, slightly furrowed brows, and closed lips. He has curly hair that reaches past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark cloak over a white shirt with a high collar visible at the neck. His hand rests on a book with a ribbon. The background is plain, with a soft, dark gradient emphasizing his presence in the image.

artworks.title: Cesare Nebbia
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the upper torso up, with a high forehead, receding brown hair, slightly curled above his ears, and a small goatee. The man looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression and slightly furrowed eyebrows. He is wearing a dark green coat with large buttons and a soft white collar, highlighted by light falling on it. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a simple, muted brown tone. The name "Cesare Nebia" is inscribed on the lower section of the image, along with other text and numbers, partially cropped by the frame.

artworks.title: Ciro Ferri
artworks.description: This image features a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has long, dark, wavy hair, softly arched eyebrows, slightly deep-set eyes, a long, straight nose, and a faint smile. He wears a loose blue garment over a white shirt with an open collar. The background is a textured brown surface. Text at the lower edge identifies the person as Ciro Ferri and credits the creator as Laurino.

artworks.title: Claudio Ridolfi
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man displaying his upper body. He is positioned slightly turned towards the right, but his head is facing the viewer, allowing a clear view of his face. The man has distinctive facial features with a prominent moustache and a short goatee. His hair is medium brown, swept back. He is wearing a deep green garment with a high, wide white collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a muted, dark tone.

artworks.title: Filippo d'Angeli
artworks.artist: Carlo Lasinio, after Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with dark hair, a mustache, and a ruffled collar. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned, set against a dark background.

artworks.title: Giovanni Battista Salvi (Il Sassoferrato)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual's upper body, with a focus on the face and shoulders. The person faces forward with a slight tilt of the head to the right. They have a medium-length beard and mustache, short hair, light-colored eyes, and a fair complexion. The individual wears an outfit with a large white collar over a dark garment. The background is a uniform, muted blue. At the bottom, there is a label with the text "GIO: BATTA-SALVI".

artworks.title: Giovanni Mazzanti
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body including the head, neck, shoulders, and upper chest. The person is slightly turned to one side, looking into the distance. They have prominent eyebrows, a slightly tilted gaze, and a subtle, closed-mouth expression. The person has long, wavy, light brown hair flowing over their shoulders. They are wearing a dark robe with a white cloth around the neck, holding a long, slim object resembling a paintbrush. A red piece of fabric is draped over one arm. The background is a muted, dark color and the bottom of the image contains text, including the name "Giovanni Massanti."

artworks.title: Marco Benefial
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a person seated in a formal, semi-profile position. The individual has distinct facial features with a fair complexion, prominent full cheeks, and a slightly serious expression. They have long, curled, white powdered hair framing the face and covering the ears. The person is dressed in a formal blue robe with a white cravat. The background is a muted neutral tone. The name "MARCO. BENEFIAL" is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Mario Nuzzi
artworks.description: The image shows a painted portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated and facing slightly left towards the viewer. His face has a serene expression, with a straight nose and lightly defined eyebrows. He has brown shoulder-length wavy hair and is wearing a blue robe with a white undergarment visible at the neckline. In his right hand, he holds an object outside the frame. The background is a simple, muted brown color.

artworks.title: Michelangelo Ricciolini
artworks.description: The image is a bust-length portrait of a person in a three-quarter view, with only the upper part of their body visible. The individual is positioned slightly to the side, with the head turned to face the viewer. They have a light complexion with distinctive facial features, including a slightly furrowed brow and a focused expression. Their hair is curly and dark brown, and they are wearing a hat with decorative elements along its band. The person is dressed in a dark, voluminous drapery with a hint of a white shirt underneath that has a ruffled collar. There is no visible jewelry. The background is a plain, brownish tone. The bottom of the image contains text identifying the subject as "MICH-AN: RICCIOLINI."

artworks.title: Morto da Feltre
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body. He is facing the viewer but slightly turned to his left. He has a neutral expression with a gaze directed outward. He has light-colored eyes, a defined nose, and a thin, trimmed beard outlining his jawline, along with mustaches. His reddish-brown hair is layered around his face and covered by a brown or green headpiece resembling a beret or cap. He is wearing a dark loose-fitting garment, possibly a robe or coat, over a lighter undergarment with a white lace or frilled neckline. There is no visible jewelry, and his hands are not shown. The background is a muted, earthy tone.

artworks.title: Niccolo Ricciolini
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with long, curly, greyish-white hair wearing a brown robe over a white shirt with a high collar. He is facing slightly to the right and looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include prominent eyes and slightly arched eyebrows. The background is a muted, earthy tone.

artworks.title: Pierino del Vaga
artworks.artist: Carlo Lasinio, after Perino del Vaga
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man with a beard and mustache, turned to his right in a three-quarter profile view. His gaze is towards the viewer. He has neatly combed back hair, a high forehead, sharp nose, and thoughtful eyes. He is wearing a dark robe with a hint of red underneath and a white collar. The background is muted brown. The lower section of the image has an inscription that reads "PIERINO del' VAGA" with additional text surrounding the name.

artworks.title: Huntsman Visiting a Lady
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a man, and a woman, in a full-body view. The man is standing on the left, holding a hat in one hand and a dead bird by its legs in the other while he stands with one knee slightly bent. The man's face is in profile, with long wavy hair that falls over his shoulders, and he has a faint mustache and beard. He is dressed in a brown vest-like garment over a white shirt with visible cuffs, along with blue trousers knee-tied with red ribbons, and black shoes. A dog is standing beside him, looking up at the bird. The woman, standing on the right, is in partial profile with her hands folded in front of her, wearing a white dress with a hood, which frames her face and covers her hair. Her expression is calm, and her attire features pinkish, wide sleeves. There is a table next to her with a red tablecloth that has a decorative pattern, and there is an object or vessel on top. The background shows a wooden staircase on the left and a darkened area behind the figures.

artworks.title: View of Nuremberg from the West [center section]
artworks.description: The etching shows a detailed view from a slightly elevated perspective, overlooking a cityscape. The horizon, featuring a bustling city with numerous spires and towers, is adorned with descriptive texts. The skyline is marked by the silhouette of buildings under a sky filled with decorative text and garlands. The artwork is characterized by fine lines typical of engraving, creating a detailed depiction in black and white. In the foreground, a pastoral scene depicts figures tending to the land, while in the distance, the cityscape shows historical architecture.

artworks.title: View of Nuremberg from the West [left section]
artworks.description: The image is a panoramic view of a town from an elevated point. The landscape and buildings are visible, with trees and buildings lining the horizon. Labels identify specific structures and areas. The illustration is detailed, with fine lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia and black tones, giving an aged feel. A pastoral scene with figures, a watermill, and a field is in the foreground. Closer to the horizon are houses and a church tightly packed together. Above the town is an ornate cartouche with Latin text and decorative elements.

artworks.title: View of Nuremberg from the West [right section]
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic view of a village landscape from an elevated vantage point. The horizon features village buildings and church steeples. The style is detailed and intricate, with fine line work suggesting engraving. Figures are visible in the fields, which are neatly cultivated. The village is densely packed with buildings and a church tower on the horizon. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and grey, highlighting the linework and composition. Above the townscape, a decorative cartouche displays text in an elaborate script, surrounded by ornate embellishments and faces.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait and Other Heads
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a man's body in a seated position facing the viewer with a neutral expression. The man's facial features include a round face, full cheeks, and a slightly furrowed brow. He has short, curly dark hair, wears round eyeglasses, a collared jacket, and a lighter garment. The left side of the image includes smaller vignettes of people in historical attire engaged in different activities, surrounded by trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Gothic Ornament with a Lady and a Parrot
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate ornamental design featuring a central human figure. The drawing depicts a person, likely female, seated or resting amidst elaborate scrollwork and foliage patterns. The figure is dressed in period costume, and the entire composition is rendered in a highly detailed and textured manner. The swirling patterns around the figure suggest a decorative motif, enhanced by dark, carefully shaded lines that define the features and texture.

artworks.title: Diana Resting
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on the ground, with a calm expression, dressed in draped clothing, holding a bow. Two animals are nearby: a deer and a dog. The background features trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing with a neutral expression. The person is standing upright on grass, with one foot slightly forward. They have distinct facial features, including a long beard and hair with a spiked halo. The figure is wearing an orange robe over a green tunic. In their right hand, they hold a sword, and in their left hand, a book with clasps. The background is a plain parchment surface, bordered by a frame that emphasizes the figure.

artworks.title: Initial S with King David as Scribe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up, seated in an ornate space. He is positioned with his body turned slightly to the right, facing a desk while holding a quill pen in his right hand close to his chin and resting his left hand on an open book. The man's facial features include a full beard and mustache with a contemplative gaze. His gray, curly hair is visible beneath a gold crown adorned with finials. He is dressed in an elaborate robe with red and yellow fabric, trimmed with white. The scene includes a small, round table with writing materials and another book, along with a wooden chair with a checkerboard patterned floor below. The background is richly decorated with gold hues, blue and purple swirling designs, and two green dragon heads protruding from the sides of the ornate letter-shaped frame, which itself includes additional decorative elements in gold and blue.

artworks.title: Initial T with a group of Benedictine monks singing before an altar from which issues water
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene contained within an illuminated letter. Within the twisting blue-and-green letter, the painting showcases a group of monks in brown robes gathered in prayer at an altar with two golden panels. An open book on a yellow stand is visible next to the monks. The altar has a white cloth draped over it, and the wall around the panels is pink. In the front, an old man with a gray beard wearing red and green robes is bent low, his hands extended below a golden spout shaped like an animal head that appears to shoot water into the ground. The scene is surrounded by the large letter, which looks like a lower-case ‘a’ shaped like a dragon-like creature and surrounded by a thick gold outline.

artworks.title: Initial A
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript letter with elaborate designs and mythical creatures. The painting depicts an ornately drawn letter with intricate patterns and vibrant colors. The letter appears surrounded by a blue creature with a goat-like head at the top and a bird-like body extending around the sides. Inside the letter, there are two identical purple creatures facing each other, nestled among green foliage and red flowers. The background is a shimmering gold. Shapes around the border of the letter give the impression of a flaming or radiant design, characteristic of medieval illuminated manuscripts.
